titulo_en: Remember doing or remember to do

titulo_es.@es: Recordar una acción o acordarse de una tarea
titulo_es.@en: Remember an action or remember a task

texto.@es: **I remember writing the email yesterday** = recuerdo haber escrito el correo ayer. La acción ocurrió y ahora la recuerdas.
texto.@en: **I remember writing the email yesterday** = I remember writing the mail yesterday. The action happened and now you remember it.

texto.@es: **Remember to attach the file before sending the email** = acuérdate de adjuntar el archivo antes de enviar el correo. Es una tarea que debes recordar hacer; **She remembered to attach it** indica que se acordó y lo hizo.
texto.@en: **Remember to attach the file before sending the email** = Remember to attach the file before sending the mail. It is a task you must remember to do; **She remembered to attach it** indicates that he remembered and did.

titulo.@es: Un correo con un archivo adjunto
titulo.@en: An email with an attached file

frases.en: Lina remembers writing an email to her tutor yesterday.
frases.es: Lina recuerda haber escrito ayer un correo a su tutor.

frases.en: She can't remember attaching the file, so she isn't sure whether the email has an attachment.
frases.es: No recuerda haber adjuntado el archivo, así que no está segura de si el correo lleva un archivo adjunto.

frases.en: This morning, she remembered to attach it before sending a new email.
frases.es: Esta mañana, se acordó de adjuntarlo antes de enviar un correo nuevo.

frases.en: She also remembered to include her phone number.
frases.es: También se acordó de incluir su número de teléfono.

frases.en: Her tutor replied a few minutes later.
frases.es: Su tutor respondió unos minutos después.

pregunta.@es: What does “Lina remembers writing an email yesterday” mean?
pregunta.@en: What does Lina members writing an email yesterday render?

opciones.texto: She has a memory of writing it yesterday.
opciones.explicacion: **Remember + -ing** refers to a memory of a past action.

opciones.texto: She needs to write it today.
opciones.explicacion: That would be a task to remember to do.

opciones.texto: She plans to write it tomorrow.

explicacion.@es: The sentence describes a past action she remembers.
explicacion.@en: The sentence describes a past action she members.

pregunta.@es: Which sentence asks someone not to forget a task?
pregunta.@en: When sentence asks something not to get a task?

opciones.texto: Remember to attach the file before sending the email.
opciones.explicacion: **Remember + to + verb** refers to a task that still needs to be done.

opciones.texto: Remember attaching the file before sending the email.
opciones.explicacion: **Remember + -ing** refers to a memory of doing it.

opciones.texto: Remember attach the file before sending the email.
opciones.explicacion: The verb needs **to** in this structure.

bloques.frase: Lina remembers ___ an email to her tutor yesterday.

opciones.texto: writing
opciones.explicacion: The writing happened yesterday and is now remembered.

opciones.texto: to write
opciones.explicacion: This would refer to remembering a task to do.

opciones.texto: wrote

explicacion.@es: A finite past verb does not follow **remember** directly here.
explicacion.@en: A final past verb does not follow **remember** directly here.

bloques.frase: This morning, she remembered ___ the file before sending a new email.

opciones.texto: to attach
opciones.explicacion: **Remember + to + verb** refers to the task she did not forget.

opciones.texto: attaching

explicacion.@es: This would mean she remembers the past action of attaching it.
explicacion.@en: This would mean she members the past action of attacking it.

opciones.texto: attach
opciones.explicacion: The verb needs **to** after **remember** in this meaning.

bloques.pregunta: Does Lina know whether she attached the file to yesterday's email?

opciones.texto: No. She can't remember attaching it.
opciones.explicacion: The second sentence says she is unsure.

opciones.texto: Yes. She remembers attaching it yesterday.
opciones.explicacion: She explicitly can't remember doing that.

opciones.texto: No. She remembers that she did not write the email.

explicacion.@es: She remembers writing it in the first sentence.
explicacion.@en: She members writing it in the first sentence.

bloques.pregunta: What did Lina remember to do before sending the new email?

opciones.texto: Attach the file and include her phone number.
opciones.explicacion: The third and fourth sentences say she remembered both tasks.

opciones.texto: Write the first email again and delete her number.
opciones.explicacion: The text does not say this.

opciones.texto: Reply to her tutor.

bloques.frase: She can't remember attaching the file.

opciones.texto: No recuerda haber adjuntado el archivo.

explicacion.@es: **Remember + -ing** trata de tener o no tener memoria de una acción pasada.
explicacion.@en: **Remember + -ing** tries to have or not have memory of a past action.

opciones.texto: Se olvidó de adjuntar el archivo.

explicacion.@es: Eso afirma que no realizó la tarea; el original solo dice que no lo recuerda.
explicacion.@en: That says he didn't do the task; the original only says he doesn't remember it.

opciones.texto: No recuerda que debe adjuntar el archivo.

explicacion.@es: Para una tarea pendiente se usa **remember + to + verb**.
explicacion.@en: For an outstanding task **remember + to + verb** is used.

bloques.frase: She remembered to include her phone number.

opciones.texto: Se acordó de incluir su número de teléfono.

explicacion.@es: **Remember + to + verb** expresa una tarea que recordó hacer.
explicacion.@en: **Remember + to + verb** expresses a task he recalled to do.

opciones.texto: Recuerda haber incluido su número de teléfono.
Se olvidó de incluir su número de teléfono.

bloques.pregunta: What happened a few minutes after Lina sent her new email?

opciones.texto: Her tutor replied.
opciones.explicacion: The final sentence gives this information.

opciones.texto: Lina sent a second attachment.

explicacion.@es: The text does not mention a second attachment.
explicacion.@en: The text does not mention a second attack.

opciones.texto: Her tutor asked her to rewrite the email.
opciones.explicacion: No such request appears in the reading.

intro.@es: **Remember + -ing** habla de un recuerdo de una acción pasada; **remember + to + verbo** habla de acordarse de una tarea pendiente.
intro.@en: **Remember + -ing** speaks of a memory of a past action; **remember + to + verbo** speaks of remembering an outstanding task.
